# Workshop tour

A self-serve copy of the HGV workshop demo for prospects, with a neutral brand
(Demo Truck Services), an email gate and a guided tour. Live at
<https://apexlineai.com/workshop-tour/>. Sample data only, nothing leaves the browser except the
gate's lead email.

## Do not edit the app files here

Every app file (`*.js` except `gate.js` and `tour.js`, `app.css`, the four `.html` pages) is
generated by `Workshop/tour/build_tour.py` from the main workshop demo, with the brand swapped
and its own storage namespace (`wsTour:`). After any change to the main demo, run:

    python3 Workshop/tour/build_tour.py

then the tour test, then push. The build stops if anything names a real customer.

## The tour's own files

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `gate.js` | Email gate (name and workshop optional), then "Guided tour" or "I'll do it myself, thanks" once per session. Posts the lead to the `enquiry` edge function, which emails apexlineai@gmail.com. Remembered in `wsTourLead`, so a returning visitor skips the gate. |
| `tour.js` | The guided tour: 17 steps over the real screens, Next, Back, Skip, the count, arrow keys and Esc. The Tour button in the demo bar starts it again. |
| `tour.css` | Gate, choice and tour styles. On a phone the card is a sheet along the bottom (or the top when the highlight is low). |
| `brand/demo-badge.svg` | The neutral logo. |

Test: `node Workshop/tests/tour.test.js` (needs localhost:8765 serving apexline-site).
